title: Japanese Genmaicha Ramen
description: A classic Japanese ramen recipe with a twist of genmaicha tea-infused flavors. This comforting bowl is perfect for a cold day.

ingredients.name: Pork Chashu
ingredients.notes: Thinly sliced pork braised in soy sauce

ingredients.name: Genmaicha Tea
ingredients.notes: Japanese green tea and roasted brown rice

instructions: 1. In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of genmaicha tea to a boil.
2. Add 1 package of ramen noodles and cook according to package instructions.
3. In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil over medium heat.
4. Add 1 cup of sliced mushrooms and cook until tender.
5. Add 1 cup of thinly sliced pork chashu and cook until heated through.
6. In a small bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons of soy sauce and 1 tablespoon of sugar.
7. Add the soy sauce mixture to the pork and mushroom mixture, and stir to combine.
8. To assemble the ramen, place cooked noodles in a bowl, then top with the pork and mushroom mixture.
9. Garnish with thinly sliced scallions and a small bunch of bok choy.
